description: Graf de execuție pentru implementarea Mirage. Nodurile sunt task-uri sau livrabile; muchiile sunt dependențe.
milestones: M1: Remote indexer skeleton & LanceDB integration
M3: KMP client engine & Vault URI parser
M4: VFS adapters (local, Dropbox, Google Drive, SMB)
M5: Search UI in Compose Desktop
M8: Local AI models (embeddings, vision, translator)
M11: Admin Web Console for Self-Hosted Worker
M13: Modular Download Manager & Optional Engines

nodes.title: Initialize repo, .agents structure and README
nodes.notes: Done at project creation.

nodes.title: Choose Remote Indexer runtime: Python vs Rust
nodes.notes: Decision needed before implementation.

nodes.title: Set up Docker container for Remote Indexer
nodes.notes: Include read-only volume mapping and env config.

nodes.title: Integrate LanceDB native core in Remote Indexer
nodes.notes: Define schema and delta generation logic.

nodes.title: Integrate ONNX Runtime for embedding inference
nodes.notes: Support int8, AVX2/NEON, optional CUDA.

nodes.title: Implement storage connectors (local, NAS/SMB, S3, Dropbox, Google Drive)
nodes.notes: Read-only access only.

nodes.title: Implement indexing pipeline: scan, extract, embed, store
nodes.notes: Use diff scanning and incremental updates.

nodes.title: Design delta sync protocol (HTTP2/gRPC)
nodes.notes: Decision updated in ADR 003: MVP uses NDJSON record streaming over HTTP instead of raw .lance files. gRPC/HTTP2 can be added later.

nodes.title: Implement /sync/delta endpoint
nodes.notes: GET /sync/delta?version={n} streams application/x-ndjson records with X-Latest-Version header. Protected by Authorization: Bearer passkey. Empty body when client is up to date.

nodes.title: Create KMP project skeleton (Compose Desktop)
nodes.notes: Target JVM desktop first. Gradle wrapper generated; build passes with JDK 21.

nodes.title: Implement Vault URI parser
nodes.notes: Parse vault://host:port#vault_id=...&key=...

nodes.title: Implement RemoteVaultManager with delta download
nodes.notes: NDJSON delta parsing with Ktor; records upserted into LocalVectorStore via SearchEngine.

nodes.title: Integrate local LanceDB in KMP
nodes.notes: LanceDB JVM unavailable on Maven Central; implemented in-memory brute-force store behind LocalVectorStore abstraction. Can be swapped with LanceDB-JVM or JNI later without UI changes.

nodes.title: Define VfsAdapter interface
nodes.notes: Methods: fetchThumbnail, openFile.

nodes.title: Implement LocalFileSystem VFS adapter
nodes.notes: Uses java.nio, Desktop API and AWT ImageIO for 64x64 PNG thumbnails.

nodes.title: Implement Dropbox VFS adapter
nodes.notes: Direct Dropbox API calls with OAuth token.

nodes.title: Implement Google Drive VFS adapter
nodes.notes: Drive REST API v3 with OAuth token.

nodes.title: Implement NAS/SMB VFS adapter
nodes.notes: JCIFS or smbj for SMB; also support direct network path.

nodes.title: Build floating search UI in Compose Desktop
nodes.notes: Spotlight/Raycast-style floating window: search input, status bar with Start indexing / Add vault buttons, Esc to hide, multi-monitor centering.

nodes.title: Implement global hotkey manager (JNativeHook)
nodes.notes: Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + Space toggles the floating search window.

nodes.title: Implement system tray manager
nodes.notes: AWT SystemTray with Show/Settings/Quit menu.

nodes.title: Implement clipboard history manager
nodes.notes: Polls system clipboard and keeps a searchable in-memory history.

nodes.title: Implement Add Server flow with server code
nodes.notes: User enters server URL + code (or full Vault URI). Client does not know managed vs self-hosted.

nodes.title: Choose offline licensing scheme (ED25519)
nodes.notes: Cancelled per ADR 007. Replaced by managed/self-hosted server code model.

nodes.title: Generate ED25519 key pair and license format
nodes.notes: Cancelled per ADR 007.

nodes.title: Implement license validation in KMP client
nodes.notes: Cancelled per ADR 007.

nodes.title: Implement 14-day trial persistence
nodes.notes: Cancelled per ADR 007.

nodes.title: Add ONNX Runtime Java dependency to KMP
nodes.notes: ONNX Runtime Java for local embeddings/vision/translator.

nodes.title: Implement local text embedder for KMP
nodes.notes: MVP: text embeddings. Vision and translator as stubs.

nodes.title: Wire local embedder into SearchEngine for real vector search
nodes.notes: Use cosine similarity on real embeddings instead of heuristic text scoring.

nodes.title: Add local vision and translator stubs
nodes.notes: Stubs for future ONNX vision/translator models.

nodes.title: Set up Rust daemon project skeleton
nodes.notes: Cargo project, logging, config loading, CLI args, shared models.

nodes.title: Implement IPC server (Unix socket + named pipe)
nodes.notes: JSON-RPC framing over Unix Domain Socket / Named Pipe; ping/status handlers; integration test passes on macOS.

nodes.title: Integrate LanceDB Rust + vector search
nodes.notes: Replace Python LanceDB with Rust LanceDB native.

nodes.title: Implement search RPC method
nodes.notes: Hybrid vector + BM25 search.

nodes.title: Integrate ONNX Runtime Rust for local embeddings
nodes.notes: Core embedder implemented in daemon_next. Needs refactor for modular/on-demand download per ADR 012.

nodes.title: Implement DuckDB analytics engine
nodes.notes: Core analytics engine implemented in daemon_next. Needs refactor for modular/on-demand download per ADR 012.

nodes.title: Build Mirage CLI binary
nodes.notes: Lightweight CLI in Rust. Design: .agents/specs/cli-mcp-design.md §1-§3.

nodes.title: Implement mirage search / query / status commands
nodes.notes: Connects to daemon IPC. Design: .agents/specs/cli-mcp-design.md §2, §4, §5.

nodes.title: Implement mirage mcp serve
nodes.notes: MCP server over stdio. Design: .agents/specs/cli-mcp-design.md §6, §7.

nodes.title: Build Admin Web Console skeleton for worker
nodes.notes: Static admin UI bundled in Docker image.

nodes.title: Implement User API Keys management endpoints
nodes.notes: Generate, rotate, revoke keys.

nodes.title: Design Modular Setup Wizard UI
nodes.notes: Wizard screens for module selection.

nodes.title: Implement Modular Setup Wizard in Compose Desktop
nodes.notes: User selects modules and approves model downloads.

nodes.title: Design module manifest format and catalog
nodes.notes: JSON schema: id, name, version, urls per platform, checksums, dependencies, size. Design doc: .agents/specs/modular-download-manager.md; schema: .agents/specs/module-manifest-schema.json.

nodes.title: Implement Modular Download Manager in daemon
nodes.notes: HTTPS download with resume, checksum verification, dependency resolution, progress events. Design doc: .agents/specs/modular-download-manager.md.

nodes.title: Refactor DuckDB analytics as downloadable module
nodes.notes: DuckDB nu mai e legat static in daemon: catalogul expune modulul runtime 'duckdb' (binar CLI oficial, SHA-256 pinuit pe 5 platforme), iar analytics.rs il ruleaza ca proces copil. Decizia initiala de libloading e inlocuita de ADR 014.

nodes.title: Refactor ONNX Runtime embedder as downloadable module
nodes.notes: ONNX Runtime loaded from downloads dir; embed/search uses fallback if missing or prompts download. Design: .agents/specs/optional-engine-refactor.md §10.

nodes.title: Implement SLM SQL generator over ONNX
nodes.notes: Multilingual ONNX model routes NL to semantic_search or sql_query, generates DuckDB SQL, and summarizes results in NL. No llama.cpp dependency. Design: .agents/specs/slm-sql-generator.md.

nodes.title: Add IPC methods for module management and SQL generation
nodes.notes: Adds IPC method ask(question) which routes to semantic_search or sql_query, generates DuckDB SQL, and summarizes results in natural language. Also methods download_module, module_status; query() detects missing DuckDB and returns structured error. Design: .agents/specs/slm-sql-generator.md §6. Optional-engine refactor design: .agents/specs/optional-engine-refactor.md §5, §6, §7.

nodes.title: Update KMP GUI to request and track module downloads
nodes.notes: Dialogs for missing modules; progress UI; settings page to add/remove modules.

nodes.title: Implement CLI commands for module and SQL generation
nodes.notes: Commands: mirage modules, mirage download <module>, mirage ask <question>. Natural language questions are answered, not raw SQL. Design: .agents/specs/cli-mcp-design.md §2.6-§2.8, §8.

nodes.title: Package Remote Indexer Docker image
nodes.notes: Multi-arch image for amd64/arm64.

nodes.title: Package Compose Desktop app installers
nodes.notes: MSI, DMG, DEB targets. Installer bundles only core daemon + KMP GUI; optional modules downloaded at runtime.

nodes.title: Write end-to-end smoke tests
nodes.notes: Spin up indexer, sync client, search and open file.

nodes.title: Real CLIP text+vision embedder in one 512-d space
nodes.notes: ViT-B/32 int8, canonical preprocessing, real BPE tokenizer; retrieval proven on six labelled photographs.

nodes.title: User-initiated indexing pass with progress reporting
nodes.notes: Watcher and settings changes only mark the index stale; index_files is the only trigger, index_status reports phase/count/percent.

nodes.title: LanceDB modality and caption columns, dimension from the embedder
nodes.notes: Table is rebuilt when the stored dimension no longer matches the loaded embedder (384 -> 512).

nodes.title: Module catalog with verified CLIP URLs, sizes and sha256
nodes.notes: Placeholder example.com entries removed; a test rejects catalog rows without a real checksum.

nodes.title: Spread the semantic result window across modalities
nodes.notes: Text scores 0.72-0.86 and images 0.22-0.29 in CLIP space; without the spread no photograph reached the visible window.

nodes.title: Settings indexing controls and module status wired to the daemon
nodes.notes: Start indexing / Re-index chip, 4dp progress bar, excluded dirs pushed back debounced, vision/semantic flags from status.modules.
